title: The Quintessential Quintuplets
by: Tezuka Productions (S1), Bibury Animation Studios (S2 and film)
summary: Fuutarou Uesugi is a top student from a poor family who takes a high-paying tutoring job to help clear his fathers debts. His students turn out to be five classmates who are quintuplets: Ichika, Nino, Miku, Yotsuba and Itsuki, all of them failing and none of them interested in studying. He has to get all five through graduation, but first he has to get any of them to actually listen to him.

title: Rascal Does Not Dream of Bunny Girl Senpai
length: 13 episodes, plus follow-up films and a second season
summary: Sakuta Azusagawa is a high schooler whose quiet routine changes when he runs into Mai Sakurajima, a famous actress wandering the library in a bunny girl outfit that nobody else seems able to see. Helping her leads him into a run of strange “Adolescence Syndrome” cases around school, each one growing out of something painfully real. It’s part supernatural mystery, part sharp banter, and a lot of heart.

title: Bocchi the Rock!
summary: Hitori “Bocchi” Gotoh is a guitarist who has practised alone for years and can barely talk to other people. When drummer Nijika pulls her into the band Kessoku Band, she has to work out how to stand on a real stage without dissolving into a puddle of anxiety. The music is great, the comedy is sharp, and Bocchi’s spiralling inner monologue is half the fun.

title: Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian
summary: Alya is a half-Russian top student who everyone finds cool and unapproachable, and who spends her days scolding Masachika Kuze, the sleepy classmate sitting next to her. She also mutters affectionate things in Russian, sure that nobody around her understands. Masachika understands every word and pretends he doesn’t. The whole show grows out of that one secret.

title: Spy x Family
length: 3 seasons, plus the film Code: White
summary: Twilight, a top-tier spy, needs a family to finish his latest mission. He becomes Loid Forger, adopts a little girl called Anya, and marries Yor, who needs a cover of her own. What none of them know is that Anya can read minds and Yor is an assassin. Each is hiding something from the other two, and somehow they end up feeling like a real family anyway.

title: More Than a Married Couple, But Not Lovers
summary: At Jiro Yakuin’s school, third-years are paired up for a “marriage practical” and have to live together as a married couple. He gets Akari Watanabe, a lively gyaru who is nothing like him, and both of them would rather have been matched with their crushes. To swap partners they need to score well as a couple, so they play house properly, and it slowly stops feeling like acting.

title: I Expect You to Die
platforms: Meta Quest, PC VR, PlayStation VR
summary: A VR spy puzzle series. You play an agent who gets dropped into deadly, escape-room-style setups and has to work out how to finish the mission before something goes badly wrong. Everything is solved with what’s within arm’s reach, and the dry, dark humour is a big part of the charm.
Three games, each one bigger and stranger than the last.

title: Red Dead Redemption 2
summary: An open-world Western set in 1899, when the outlaw era is fading and the law is closing in. You play Arthur Morgan, an enforcer in the Van der Linde gang, as the crew runs from one job to the next and starts to come apart from the inside. It’s known for its slow, detailed world and a story that takes its time before it hits you.

title: Forza Horizon 6
summary: The open-world racing series heads to Japan, with Tokyo as its biggest and most detailed drivable space yet. There are around 550 cars at launch, plenty of them kei cars and vans, and the roads run from city streets to mountain passes made for drifting. This time you start out as a tourist and earn your way up through the Horizon Festival.

title: Doki Doki Literature Club!
summary: A free visual novel that starts out as a sweet story about joining your school’s literature club and getting to know its four members. It doesn’t stay that way. It’s best to go in knowing as little as possible, and it opens with a content warning, so read that first.

title: Zenless Zone Zero
platforms: PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, iOS, Android
summary: A stylish urban-fantasy action RPG set in New Eridu, a city that survived the disasters known as Hollows. You play a Proxy, someone who guides squads of agents through those Hollows, and the fights are fast and flashy with a soundtrack to match.

title: Rec Room
platforms: VR, PC, PlayStation, Xbox, iOS, Android
summary: A free social platform where you could hang out, play games and build your own rooms, on VR, consoles, PC and mobile. Over a decade it grew to more than 150 million players and creators. It shut down on June 1, 2026.

title: Firewatch
summary: You play Henry, who takes a summer job as a fire lookout in Wyoming’s Shoshone National Forest in 1989, with only a radio and his supervisor Delilah for company. It’s a first-person story about isolation and trust that slowly turns into a mystery about who else is out there.

title: Dead as Disco
summary: A rhythm brawler where every punch, kick and dodge lands on the beat. You play Charlie Disco, a dead drummer who rises for one night to take on his old bandmates and the corporation running them. You can also load in your own songs and fight to them.

title: Fears to Fathom
summary: An episodic horror series where each episode is a short, self-contained story about an ordinary situation turning frightening, inspired by scares that real people described.
Episode 1 is Home Alone and episode 2 is Norwood Hitchhike.

title: Minecraft
summary: A sandbox game where you explore a world made of blocks, gather resources and build whatever you can imagine, from a tiny dirt hut to a full-scale castle. Survive the night in survival mode or build freely in creative mode. Either way, you set your own goals.
